messages.subject: there's merch
messages.body_plain:
hi,

while our homepage received a face-lift (see https://rkward.kde.org ) and 
we're thinking about what needs to be done for a next release, we've managed 
to set up a merch store. that is, if you were among the people interested in a 
t-shirt, bag or coffee mug with the RKWard logo, christmas comes early:

  https://shop.spreadshirt.de/rkward/

let me know if you're missing something ;)


viele grüße :: m.eik


-- 
  dipl. psych. meik michalke
  institut f"ur experimentelle psychologie
  abt. f"ur diagnostik und differentielle psychologie
